The evening’s first winner was Kate O’Flynn, who took Supporting Actress in a Comedy Series for the Apple TV freshman show. The Supporting Actor in a Comedy Series prize later went to her fellow Widow’s Bay co-star Stephen Root. It was the first Emmy for both. Series creator Katie Dippold later won her first Emmy for Writing for a Comedy Series and then a second for producing the horror comedy.
